$comment: PCB verification, rebuilt 2026-11-05 after the deep pass. Model: .research-cache/scripts/pcb_ref_official.py (table row on floor(P), RM10 tested before rounding, one round-up on the final amount, unrounded Step 1[E], unfloored net in a bonus month). 'official' = LHDN published results. 'lhdnCalculator2024' = output of LHDN's Kalkulator PCB, year 2024 page only, run over plain HTTP on 2026-11-05: YA2025/26 by proxy, same Table 1 and spec wording. 'computed' = our model, not LHDN output. EPF in computed cases comes from docs/research/data/epf-third-schedule-2025-10-partA.json unless the case name says part E or part C.

official17.cases: Spec Exhibit 5 Jan-Apr (4), slides p18 (1), slides p20 Jan-Dec (12)

oldModelPcbRefPy.note: pcb_ref.py matches the published examples but not the calculator. Do not use it.

official.source: MTD spec 2026 Exhibit 5 (labelled Jan-Apr 2025); spec 2025 Exhibit 5 has identical numbers (labelled Jan-Apr 2024)

inputs.note: Kt 908 is LHDN published input. The Third Schedule gives 913 (1,518 on 13,750 minus 605); April payable is 833.70 either way because the RM4,000 cap is already reached.

official.source: LHDN PCB briefing slides 2024 p18-19 (Kalkulator PCB output)
LHDN PCB briefing slides 2024 p20 ('sebenar' 2023, same tax table as YA2025/26)
GPO 1/2024 s7.2 Contoh 4, computerised method (uses YA2022 8% band)
official.explanation: Not part of the 17. Published figures stop before the 5-sen round-up; 807.40 is model-computed. GPO rounds K2 half-up (317.64), while the spec and calculator truncate (317.63); this does not change these figures. This example supports the unrounded Step 1[E].

selected.label: Bonus month: negative net offsets the bonus MTD
Raw below RM10 becomes 0 and feeds Step 1[E]
Round up once on the sum

rulings.note: Zakat paid by the husband with no income is not claimable by the wife. YA2022 rates; same 570 on YA2026 brackets.

computed.ya2027_proposed_note: YA2027 uses the proposed Budget 2027 rates, B values we derived, and D = 12,000. Illustrative only.

nonResident_ya2025_2026.rule: 30% x remuneration, then 2 dp, below RM10 -> 0, round up to next 5 sen

computed.partF_note: Resident foreign employee, Part F, RM5,000: EPF RM100 per the deep-pass to-do T5, medium confidence; no Part F data file existed when this was computed. P 49,800, tax 1,488, MTD 124.00.

thresholdsNote: Each entry: jan = [first whole-ringgit salary with PCB in January, its PCB, its EPF]; any = [first salary with PCB in any month, the month, that month's PCB, year total]. Prefix A, E, C = Third Schedule part.

socsoEis.source: socso-act4-2025.json, socso-act4-2026.json phase 1, socso-skbbk-2026.json, eis-2025.json; First Category, under 60

terminationExamples.setup: Single, Y1 8,000, EPF 880, paid in June, Kt 0, salary projection kept. Keys are Yt; 0 = no lump sum.

overtimeExamples.setup: Single, Category 1, no EPF on overtime. Y1 is the LHDN route. Computed, not LHDN output.
